target: next five one-session adjusted-close log returns; reconstructed path and arithmetic mean price

split.purge: all five target sessions must remain within origin split

models.arima: per-symbol ARIMA(1,0,1), refit every 21 scored origins; refit checkpoints saved
models.xgboost: pooled five direct regressors with one-hot symbol columns, refit every 63 scored market dates; all horizon checkpoints saved

fit_artifacts: New aligned model checkpoints are saved under models/; legacy checkpoints are not reused.
